Role access map

What each role can and cannot do. New accounts are always Learners; other roles are assigned by administrators.

RolePermitted scopeSeparation control
LearnerOwn profile, entitled learning, drafts, submissions, evidence, support cases, consent.Cannot review, verify, administer or view another learner's private evidence.
ReviewerAssigned submissions, rubric review, feedback, request changes, approval queue, workload.No self-review; cannot independently verify their own approvals.
VerifierIndependent verification queue, evidence review, conflict declaration, decision, audit.Cannot verify work they reviewed, approved, worked with, or have a declared relationship with.
AdminConfiguration, products, entitlements, assignments, publishing, audit and system health.Privileged approval and MFA in production; separated from review decisions.
